cards.target: Ci manda un messaggio.
cards.english: He sends us a message.

cards.target: Ti ho mandato un messaggio.
cards.english: I sent you a message.

cards.target: Se ti chiede scusa, perdonalo.
cards.english: If he apologizes, forgive him.

cards.target: Voleva sapere quando saremmo partiti.
cards.english: He wanted to know when we would leave.

cards.target: Il palazzo è stato ristrutturato completamente.
cards.english: The building was completely renovated.

cards.target: Le email vengono controllate ogni mattina.
cards.english: Emails are checked every morning.

cards.target: Se avessi tempo, viaggerei di più.
cards.english: If I had time, I'd travel more.

cards.target: Come si dice 'grazie' in giapponese?
cards.english: How do you say 'thank you' in Japanese?

cards.target: Se avessi tempo, viaggerei per tutta l'Italia.
cards.english: If I had time, I'd travel all over Italy.

cards.target: Come si arriva alla stazione da qui?
cards.english: How do you get to the station from here?

cards.target: Dunque, cosa facciamo adesso con questo problema?
cards.english: So, what do we do now with this problem?

cards.target: Innanzitutto, è necessario capire bene il problema.
cards.english: First and foremost, it's necessary to understand the problem well.

cards.target: Si prevede che domani ci sarà il sole.
cards.english: It's forecast to be sunny tomorrow.

cards.target: Se la macchina funzionasse, andremmo noi a prenderti.
cards.english: If the car worked, we'd come pick you up.

cards.target: La verità va detta, anche quando è scomoda.
cards.english: The truth must be told, even when it's uncomfortable.

cards.target: Il latte va conservato in frigorifero dopo l'apertura.
cards.english: Milk must be kept in the refrigerator after opening.

cards.target: Inoltre, è necessario presentare anche una foto tessera.
cards.english: Furthermore, it's also necessary to provide an ID photo.

cards.target: Prima di tutto, assicuriamoci che tutti siano presenti.
cards.english: First of all, let's make sure everyone is present.

cards.target: Se non piove, facciamo una passeggiata al parco.
cards.english: If it doesn't rain, let's take a walk in the park.

cards.target: Se ti va, possiamo guardare un film insieme.
cards.english: If you feel like it, we can watch a movie together.

cards.target: Se hai tempo, passa a trovarci questo fine settimana.
cards.english: If you have time, come visit us this weekend.

cards.target: Il Colosseo è stato costruito quasi duemila anni fa.
cards.english: The Colosseum was built almost two thousand years ago.

cards.target: Se tutto va come previsto, ci sposeremo a giugno.
cards.english: If everything goes as planned, we'll get married in June.

cards.target: La bolletta va pagata entro la fine del mese.
cards.english: The bill must be paid by the end of the month.

cards.target: Poiché il treno era in ritardo, abbiamo perso la coincidenza.
cards.english: Since the train was late, we missed the connection.

cards.target: Mi ha suggerito di provare quel ristorante vicino al porto.
cards.english: He suggested I try that restaurant near the port.

cards.target: Continua a nevicare e le strade sono sempre più pericolose.
cards.english: It keeps snowing and the roads are getting more dangerous.

cards.target: Mia madre mi ha pregato di non tornare troppo tardi.
cards.english: My mother begged me not to come back too late.

cards.target: Se avessi ascoltato i miei genitori, non avrei fatto quell'errore.
cards.english: If I had listened to my parents, I wouldn't have made that mistake.

cards.target: Ha spiegato che aveva perso il treno per un solo minuto.
cards.english: He explained that he had missed the train by just one minute.

cards.target: Voleva sapere a che ora partisse il prossimo treno per Firenze.
cards.english: She wanted to know what time the next train to Florence left.

cards.target: Mi ha chiesto se per caso conoscessi un buon ristorante in zona.
cards.english: He asked me if by any chance I knew a good restaurant in the area.

cards.target: Se piove, resto a casa.
cards.english: If it rains, I stay home.

cards.target: Se potessimo permettercelo, cambieremmo casa.
cards.english: If we could afford it, we'd move.

cards.target: Nel caso piovesse, porto l'ombrello.
cards.english: In case it rains, I'll bring the umbrella.

cards.target: La cena verrà servita alle otto.
cards.english: Dinner will be served at eight.

cards.target: L'ordine è stato confermato via email.
cards.english: The order was confirmed by email.

cards.target: Si vendono appartamenti in centro città.
cards.english: Apartments are for sale in the city center.

cards.target: Se lavori sodo, otterrai una promozione.
cards.english: If you work hard, you'll get a promotion.

cards.target: L'acqua viene distribuita gratuitamente durante l'evento.
cards.english: Water is distributed for free during the event.

cards.target: Se avessi studiato, avrei superato l'esame.
cards.english: If I had studied, I would have passed the exam.

cards.target: In questa azienda si parla anche inglese.
cards.english: English is also spoken in this company.

cards.target: Non si possono portare animali nel museo.
cards.english: Animals cannot be brought into the museum.

cards.target: Rispetto all'anno scorso, i prezzi sono aumentati.
cards.english: Compared to last year, prices have increased.

cards.target: Si capisce subito che è straniero dall'accento.
cards.english: You can tell right away from the accent that someone is foreign.

cards.target: Si prega di mantenere il silenzio in biblioteca.
cards.english: Please maintain silence in the library.

cards.target: Se non ricordo male, ci siamo già conosciuti.
cards.english: If I remember correctly, we've already met.

cards.target: La posta viene consegnata ogni mattina alle dieci.
cards.english: Mail is delivered every morning at ten.

cards.target: Pertanto, la riunione è stata rinviata a domani.
cards.english: Therefore, the meeting has been postponed to tomorrow.

cards.target: Per concludere, desidero augurare a tutti buone vacanze.
cards.english: To conclude, I wish everyone a happy vacation.

cards.target: Se fossi più coraggioso, direi quello che penso.
cards.english: If I were braver, I'd say what I think.

cards.target: Si sente il profumo del pane appena sfornato.
cards.english: You can smell the scent of freshly baked bread.

cards.target: L'italiano è parlato in diversi paesi del mondo.
cards.english: Italian is spoken in several countries in the world.

cards.target: Dunque, la conclusione è che dobbiamo cambiare strategia.
cards.english: So, the conclusion is that we need to change strategy.

cards.target: Pur non volendo, ha dovuto accettare il trasferimento.
cards.english: Despite not wanting to, he had to accept the transfer.

cards.target: Se avessi portato l'ombrello, non mi sarei bagnato.
cards.english: If I had brought an umbrella, I wouldn't have gotten wet.

cards.target: Se posso permettermi un consiglio, parlane con calma.
cards.english: If I may give you some advice, talk about it calmly.

cards.target: Se potessimo permettercelo, faremmo un viaggio ogni mese.
cards.english: If we could afford it, we'd take a trip every month.

cards.target: Se avessero chiesto indicazioni, non si sarebbero persi.
cards.english: If they had asked for directions, they wouldn't have gotten lost.

cards.target: Il libro è stato scritto da un autore famoso.
cards.english: The book was written by a famous author.

existing_tips: "Si" passivante with plural: verb agrees with the noun. "Si vendono case" = Houses are sold. The nou
"Si è" – impersonal with essere, adjective agrees in plural.
'Si' impersonal: si + third person for general statements.
"Se fossi te" – common Type 2 structure for giving advice.
"Poiché" – formal connector meaning 'since/because', usually at sentence start.
